lines.text: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did, and he was commended as righteous.
By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death, because God had taken him away.
In godly fear, Noah built a tower to save his family after being warned about things not yet seen.
Abraham obeyed and went without knowing where he was going, then lived in palaces in the promised land.
They died in faith, longed for a better, heavenly country, and God has prepared a city for them.
